Grand Theft Auto - Vice City Stories.name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories
Grand Theft Auto - Vice City Stories.summary: The PlayStation Portable follow-up to Rockstar's monumental handheld entry in the series, Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories. As in Liberty City Stories, this game ventures back to the location of the second PS2 game.

Hatsune Miku - Project Diva.name: Hatsune Miku: Project Diva
Hatsune Miku - Project Diva.summary: Hatsune Miku: Project Diva is a rhythm game and the first game in the Project Diva series. The game primarily makes use of Vocaloids, a series of singing synthesizer software, and the songs created using these Vocaloids most notably the virtual-diva Vocaloid Hatsune Miku. The game is the first video game to utilize the Vocaloid software developed by the Yamaha Corporation. In addition, Sega has released Hatsune Miku: Project Diva Dreamy Theater, a downloadable game on the PlayStation Network for the PlayStation 3. It allows players to play Project Diva on the PlayStation 3 with updated visuals though it requires the PlayStation Portable to be plugged into the PlayStation 3 via a USB cable.

Idolmaster Shiny Festa, The - Groovy Tun.name: The Idolmaster: Shiny Festa - Groovy Tune
Idolmaster Shiny Festa, The - Groovy Tun.summary:
The Idolmaster: Shiny Festa is a series of three Japanese rhythm video games. The games are part of The Idolmaster series of games, and were originally released as Honey Sound, Funky Note, and Groovy Tune. They were the first games in the series to be localized into English.
The gameplay in Shiny Festa eschews the simulation format of previous Idolmaster games, and instead features a rhythmic gameplay in which the player times the presses of buttons to the rhythm of the songs and a predetermined pattern displayed on the screen.

Persona 3 Portable.name: Persona 3 Portable
Persona 3 Portable.summary: Persona 3 Portable is an enhanced remake of Persona 3 for the PlayStation Portable. The game features an option to play as a female character, which alters some aspects of the story. In addition to the new playable character, there are two new difficulty levels to select from alongside the original game's three. The game also features some other story related changes regardless of the player character gender. The battle system is also updated to be closer that of Persona 4.

Star Ocean - Second Evolution.name: Star Ocean: Second Evolution
Star Ocean - Second Evolution.summary:
Enhanced remastered of Star Ocean: The Second Story exclusively for PSP
New high-quality animated cut scenes and character designs by Production I.G.
Characters will now change facial expressions depending on their mood
Revised game engine and improved real-time battle system keep players immersed in the action
More private actions and extensive new fully-voiced dialogue bring the story to life

Ultra Puzzle Bobble Pocket.name: Bust-a-Move: Deluxe
Ultra Puzzle Bobble Pocket.summary: Join Bob and Bub plus new characters, never before seen games and ways to play including spooky Ghost Mode! Pop matching colored bubbles to solve puzzles in a variety of game types including head-to-head play. Whether you are a first-timer or an expert bubble launcher, you will be sure to find brain-teasing fun in the over 1000 puzzles available in Bust-A-Move Deluxe!
